workarounds.symptom: Windows: a file named `nul` in the repo makes every index_repository abort with aborted_previous_preserved (0.11.0)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pipeline): skip a file named nul in the control-file walk instead of aborting the index (#2646). Target files: src/pipeline/pipeline_incremental.c, tests/test_pipeline.c. On Windows, one file named `nul` in a repository makes every `index_repository` run return `aborted_previous_preserved`, so a project without an index never gets one. Git Bash leaves such a file behind after `cmd > nul` or `2>nul`, and listing it in `.gitignore` does not help. (Ref: https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/pull/2903)
